Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL item-quality progression approval sheet for a painted volumetric cartoon fantasy RPG/tower-defense game. Create a clean wide landscape high-detail concept sheet on a warm ivory/pearl background, plum headings, fine silver separation lines, restrained turquoise accent. Eight EXACTLY aligned columns and THREE rows of large individual item icons. The column headers, left to right, must be exactly "F", "E", "D", "C", "B", "A", "S", "SSS". No SS, no SSSS. All eight columns equal width, with clear spacing. Rows are exactly "Лук", "Кирка", "Шлем". Draw one single base item lineage for each row in the same orientation and scale through all eight qualities, not unrelated weapons/classes. Painted strong silhouettes, soft material volumes, crisp edges, readable at in-game icon size. This sheet must prove the OBJECT design changes, not merely a frame color.
F: ugly crude brown branch bow with basic string, rough simple pickaxe head lashed to brown wood, coarse brown hide/leather cap. E: roughly shaped dark iron fittings/heads and simple stitched reinforced cap. D: clean purposeful iron/steel craftsmanship, steel reinforcement and helmet. C: finer cool polished steel and restrained silver detailing, still practical same identity. B: elegant steel silhouettes with restrained deep plum inlays/fittings. A: richer scarlet/red accents integrated into metal/leather, refined purposeful ornate construction. S: unmistakable rich polished gold trim/engraving on steel, noble controlled finish. SSS: magnificently refined radiant pale gold craftsmanship with rich gold and pearly-white inlay; a slight contained magical sheen, no flames/sparks or huge effects covering the silhouette. B/A/S/SSS get progressively more refined, but no enormous impractical shapes, new elemental powers or named variants. These material/colour assignments are proposals for approval, not extra gameplay resource types. The higher-quality bow remains a bow, the pickaxe remains a useful mining tool, the helmet remains recognizable as protective headgear.
All three rows aligned under the same quality headers; keep equal generous icon cells. Small identical tag "LVL 1" under EACH column to make it explicit that numerical level is unchanged while QUALITY evolves. Main title verbatim "КАЧЕСТВО ПРЕДМЕТОВ". Short subtitle "Один тип · восемь качеств". Bottom caption "Уровень 1–100 развивается отдельно". No stat numbers, no rarity loot drop rates, no extra item types or skill UI. No copied game assets, no brand, no watermark. Beautiful cohesive original premium game-art approval board.
